# Musaed (مساعد)

> Musaed is an Arabic (Saudi dialect) moderation and automation bot for Discord servers.
> It is written in Arabic from the ground up — every command, reply, error message and
> duration input is native Arabic, not a translation layer. Core features are free for
> every server with no time limit and no card; an optional Pro tier raises some limits.

Musaed's features are independent and toggled per server: moderation with a full audit
log; automatic protection (a banned-word filter that also catches stretched-out, spaced,
symbol-swapped and Arabizi spellings and edited messages, with an optional ready-made word
list from the Musaed team; spam detection; raid defense); anti-nuke protection, on by
default, which strips the roles of anyone mass-deleting channels or roles, mass-banning or
mass-kicking members, creating webhooks or adding bots, kicks the bots they added, alerts
staff, and instantly bans anyone who gives @everyone a dangerous permission (taking the
permission back); an account-age gate; captcha verification (in the
verification channel or by DM, button or math at three difficulty levels); welcome and
goodbye messages with a picture card (avatar, name, member number); separate auto-roles for
new members and new bots; a self-roles panel (up to 10 buttons with emoji and colour that
members click to take or drop a role); support tickets; auto-responses, optionally with an
image, PDF or text file; text shortcuts for quick moderation; a trap channel that mutes, kicks or
bans anyone who posts in a channel marked off-limits; a server log channel (message
deletes and edits, joins and leaves, role and nickname changes, channel and role creates
and deletes — nothing stored by Musaed); and /checkup, plus a one-time alert when an
enabled feature stops working. Most settings are configured from
the dashboard at https://dashboard.musaed.dev; a few systems also have in-chat setup
commands. Durations can be written in plain Arabic ("أسبوع", "30 يوم") or the short form
(1h30m).

This site (musaed.dev) is a static marketing and documentation site: a landing page, a
privacy policy, terms of use, and an Arabic-only user guide. It has no login, no account,
and no connection to the bot's data — the bot enforces strict per-server data isolation.
The landing page is bilingual: Arabic loads by default, with a one-click toggle to English
(?lang=ar / ?lang=en also force a language). The user guide and the legal pages are Arabic
only. All visible copy on the landing page, including the join-gate demo and the
interactive dashboard preview, is illustrative UI, not live data from any server.

## Pages

- [Landing page](https://musaed.dev/): what the bot does, an animated join-gate demo, partner servers, a 22-second video (Arabic on-screen text), the five protection layers (age gate, captcha, trap channel, automod, anti-nuke), the toolkit (tickets, shortcuts, auto-responses, welcome/goodbye/auto-role, mod logs, server log, server checkup, self-roles), an interactive dashboard preview, the searchable command list, data retention, plans, and an FAQ
- [Privacy policy](https://musaed.dev/privacy.html)
- [Terms of use](https://musaed.dev/terms.html)
- [Structured pricing](https://musaed.dev/pricing.txt)

## User guide (Arabic, Saudi dialect)

- [Guide home](https://musaed.dev/guide/): searchable hub linking to every section below
- [Getting started](https://musaed.dev/guide/start.html): adding the bot, why its role must sit above the roles it manages, the dashboard and which Discord permission configures which feature, a suggested setup order, and the /checkup command
- [Protection](https://musaed.dev/guide/protection.html): the age gate, captcha (button or math, DM or verification channel, lockdown mode), the trap channel, automod (banned words, the team word list, spam) and anti-nuke — each with its defaults, setup steps and known limits
- [Toolkit](https://musaed.dev/guide/toolkit.html): tickets, shortcuts, auto-responses, welcome/goodbye messages and auto-roles, the moderation log and /lookup, the server log, checkup alerts, and the self-roles panel
- [Commands](https://musaed.dev/guide/commands.html): every slash command with the Discord permission it needs, and how to write durations (30m, 1h30m, 7d)
- [Troubleshooting](https://musaed.dev/guide/troubleshooting.html): role-hierarchy errors, missing channel permissions, settings that will not enable or apply, captcha lockdown after a role change, and reversing a mistaken kick, ban or timeout

## Key facts

- Language: Arabic (Saudi dialect) by default, English available as a toggle; right-to-left in Arabic
- Platform: Discord
- Pricing: all systems free for every server, no time limit, no card; Pro is not yet launched — "coming soon", no numeric price, assigned by the Musaed team when it ships (no self-serve checkout)
- Add the bot: https://discord.com/oauth2/authorize?client_id=1341863717247258655&permissions=8&scope=bot+applications.commands
- Dashboard: https://dashboard.musaed.dev
- Community / support server: https://discord.gg/CcwRT6K5qv
- Short videos: https://www.youtube.com/@musaed_dev · https://www.tiktok.com/@musaed_dev · https://www.instagram.com/musaed_dev
- GitHub: https://github.com/musaed-dev (the website's source is public there; the bot's is not)

## Not this site

- Musaed is not affiliated with Discord.
- The dashboard (dashboard.musaed.dev) is a separate application with its own login.
- There is no public API, no user accounts, and no downloadable software — Musaed runs as a hosted Discord bot.
